info.name: LoungeAccessSystem API
info.description:
# Airport Lounge Access System - API test collection

## Setup
1. Start the app from a **fresh JVM**: `mvn spring-boot:run` (H2 is in-memory, demo data is re-seeded on every start).
2. Postman -> **Import** `LoungeAccessSystem.postman_collection.json` and `LoungeAccessSystem.postman_environment.json`; select the *LoungeAccessSystem - Local* environment.
3. Credentials are HTTP Basic `reception` / `lounge@123` (collection-level auth, change in the environment if you changed `lounge.security.*`).

## Running
* **Collection Runner** (recommended): run all folders in order, delay 0 ms, *Persist variables* off. Every request has tests; the whole run should be green.
* **Manual**: open a request, read its *Description* (purpose, preconditions, steps, expected result), press **Send**, check **Test Results**.
* Folders are order-dependent: tests store pass tokens in collection variables (`passToken_*`) and later folders consume them, and approvals consume quota/vouchers.
* **Re-running** the whole collection needs an app restart (quota, vouchers and passes are real state). Before restarting, you can also reset the collection variables `passToken_*`.

## Coverage map
| Folder | Verifies |
|---|---|
| 00 | App up, OpenAPI public, 401 without/with wrong credentials |
| 01 | Axis 3-month spend rule, exclusions (fuel/cash/wallet), new-card exception, idempotent re-issue |
| 02 | HDFC debit: spend + voucher (missing / malformed / unknown / other card / used / expired / valid), single-use voucher |
| 03 | HDFC credit tiers: Infinia unlimited, Millennia quota, Regalia Gold approve |
| 04 | Generic fallback (ICICI) and UNSUPPORTED_CARD (Kotak) |
| 05 | BIN lookup, CARD_NOT_FOUND, CUSTOMER_MISMATCH, bean validation, malformed JSON |
| 06 | Full quota exhaustion on a 3-visit card |
| 07 | Redeem happy path, double redeem, wrong lounge, unknown token, validation |
| 08 | Analytics: totals, rates, denial breakdown, banks, tiers, peak hours, parameter validation |

## Manual-only scenarios (not automatable in one run)
* **Expired pass (HTTP 410)**: start with `--lounge.pass.validity-minutes=1`, run 1.1, wait 61 seconds, run 7.4 -> 410 Gone with *Pass expired*. The quota is released automatically (re-run 1.1 -> new pass, `visitsRemaining` back to 1).
* **Blocked / expired card (CARD_INACTIVE)**: in the H2 console (`/h2-console`, JDBC URL `jdbc:h2:mem:loungedb`, user `sa`) run `UPDATE cards SET active = FALSE WHERE last4 = '0011';` then run 1.1 -> `CARD_INACTIVE`.
* **Quarter / month boundaries**: demo data is generated relative to today. To test boundaries, insert rows into `spend_history` with dates on the first/last day of the window and re-run the relevant request.
* **Concurrency**: fire request 6.1 twice in parallel (Runner with iterations is sequential; use two Postman windows or `curl &`) - the card row lock guarantees quota is never over-consumed.

## Test-data cheat sheet
| customerId | PAN | Scenario |
|---:|---|---|
| 1 | 4147200000000011 | Axis ACE qualifying |
| 2 | 4147200000000029 | Axis ACE new card |
| 3 | 4147200000000037 | Axis ACE low spend |
| 4 | 4386100000000013 | HDFC Platinum Debit (vouchers 482915037261 valid, 719304286150 expired, 260481937502 used) |
| 5 | 4386100000000021 | HDFC Platinum Debit low spend (voucher 530918274466) |
| 6 | 4386200000000019 | HDFC Infinia |
| 7 | 5241900000000012 | HDFC Millennia, quota used |
| 8 | 5241910000000010 | HDFC Regalia Gold |
| 9 | 6521000000000012 | ICICI Coral |
| 10 | 4000100000000018 | Kotak (unsupported) |

item.name: 00 - Smoke & Security
item.description: Run first. Confirms the app is up, Swagger is reachable and the API is protected by HTTP Basic.

request.description:
**Purpose**
Verify the service is running and OpenAPI docs are public.

**Preconditions**
Application started with `mvn spring-boot:run` (port 8080).

**Steps**
1. Send the request without credentials.

**Expected result**
200 and an OpenAPI document containing the three lounge/analytics paths.

**Purpose**
Prove the business API cannot be called anonymously.

**Preconditions**
Application running.

**Steps**
1. Send the request with **No Auth** (already overridden on this request).

**Expected result**
401 Unauthorized.

**Purpose**
Prove bad credentials are refused.

**Preconditions**
Application running.

**Steps**
1. Send the request with a deliberately wrong Basic password (set on this request).

**Expected result**
401 Unauthorized.

item.name: 01 - Axis Bank (spend-linked, 3 months)
item.description: Axis rule: >= INR 50,000 qualifying spend in the preceding 3 full calendar months (cash, wallet reload and fuel excluded). New-card exception waives spend until the end of (issue month + 3). Quota 2 visits per quarter.

exec: pm.test("HTTP 200 (a business outcome is always returned as 200)", () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));

request.description:
**Purpose**
Customer 1 spent 35,000 + 18,000 + 9,000 = 62,000 in the preceding 3 months.

**Preconditions**
Fresh application start (demo data loaded). Authentication is inherited from the collection (HTTP Basic using `{{username}}` / `{{password}}`).

**Steps**
1. Open the request body: card `{{pan_axis_ok}}`, customer `{{cust_axis_ok}}`, lounge `{{loungeId}}`.
2. Click **Send**.
3. Check the **Test Results** tab - all tests must pass.
4. The pass token is stored in the collection variable `passToken_axis` (used later by the redeem tests).

**Expected result**
`eligible=true`, `visitsRemaining=1` (2 per quarter, this entry uses one), `loungePassToken` = `LP-...`.

item.name: 1.2 Axis ACE - same card, same lounge again -> same pass (idempotent)

exec: pm.test("HTTP 200 (a business outcome is always returned as 200)", () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));
pm.test("same pass re-issued (idempotent, no extra visit consumed)", () => pm.expect(j.loungePassToken).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get("passToken_axis")));

request.description:
**Purpose**
A double-tap at the desk must not burn a second visit.

**Preconditions**
Request 1.1 has just been executed and its pass is still valid (120 min).

**Steps**
1. Send the identical request as 1.1.
2. Compare `loungePassToken` with the one from 1.1 (test does this automatically).

**Expected result**
`eligible=true` and the **same** token; `visitsRemaining` stays 1.

item.name: 1.3 Axis ACE - new card exception (no spend) -> APPROVED

exec: pm.test("HTTP 200 (a business outcome is always returned as 200)", () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));

request.description:

Customer 2's card was issued 20 days ago and has zero spend; the spend requirement is waived.

Demo data loaded.

**Steps**
1. Send the request.
2. Read `reason` - it states that the spend requirement is waived until a date.

**Expected result**
`eligible=true`, `visitsRemaining=1`, reason contains `waived`.

exec: pm.test("HTTP 200 (a business outcome is always returned as 200)", () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));

request.description:
**Purpose**
Customer 3 has 20,000 retail spend in the window. The 25,000 fuel, 15,000 cash, 6,000 wallet reload and 40,000 spent in the *current* month do not count.

**Preconditions**
Demo data loaded.

**Steps**
1. Send the request.
2. Confirm the reason quotes a qualifying spend of 20000.00 vs the required 50000.00.

**Expected result**
`eligible=false`, `denialReason=INSUFFICIENT_SPEND`, no token.

item.name: 02 - HDFC Debit (quarterly spend + 12-digit voucher)
item.description: HDFC debit rule: >= INR 10,000 qualifying spend in the previous calendar quarter AND a valid, unused 12-digit voucher issued before entry. **Run in order**: the denial cases run before the approval so no pass exists yet (a live pass for the same lounge is returned as-is, which would mask later denials).

exec: pm.test("HTTP 200 (a business outcome is always returned as 200)", () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));

request.description:

exec: pm.test("HTTP 200 (a business outcome is always returned as 200)", () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));
pm.test("reason mentions \"already been used\"", () => pm.expect(j.reason).to.include("already been used"));

request.description:

request.description:

item.name: 05 - Card lookup & validation edge cases
item.description: Card resolution (full PAN or BIN), ownership checks and request validation.

item.name: 5.1 Look up by 6-digit BIN -> resolves customer's card

exec: pm.test("HTTP 200 (a business outcome is always returned as 200)", () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));
pm.test("same pass re-issued (idempotent, no extra visit consumed)", () => pm.expect(j.loungePassToken).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get("passToken_axis")));

request.description:
**Purpose**
Reception may only have the BIN; it is resolved within the customer's own cards.

**Preconditions**
Request 1.1 executed (customer 1 has a live pass).

**Steps**
1. Send the request with `cardNumber=414720`, customer 1.

**Expected result**
Resolves to the Axis ACE card and re-issues its live pass (`eligible=true`, same token).

exec: pm.test("HTTP 200 (a business outcome is always returned as 200)", () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));

request.description:

item.name: 5.3 Card belongs to someone else -> CUSTOMER_MISMATCH

exec: pm.test("HTTP 200 (a business outcome is always returned as 200)", () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));

request.description:

exec: pm.test("HTTP 200 (a business outcome is always returned as 200)", () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));

request.description:
**Purpose**
9-11 digits is neither a BIN (6-8) nor a PAN (13-19); passes bean validation but is refused by the service.

**Preconditions**
None.

**Steps**
1. Send the request with `cardNumber=123456789`.

**Expected result**
`eligible=false`, `denialReason=CARD_NOT_FOUND`.

**Purpose**
Bean-validation failure returns an RFC 7807 problem with per-field errors.

**Preconditions**
None.

**Steps**
1. Send an empty JSON object `{}`.

**Expected result**
400 with `errors.cardNumber`, `errors.customerId`, `errors.loungeId`.

item.name: 5.6 Validation - illegal characters in card number -> 400

request.description:
**Purpose**
Card number must be 6-25 digits/spaces/hyphens.

**Preconditions**
None.

**Steps**
1. Send `cardNumber=ABCD-EFGH`.

**Expected result**
400 with `errors.cardNumber`.

**Purpose**
Unparseable body is rejected cleanly.

**Preconditions**
None.

**Steps**
1. Send a body that is not valid JSON.

**Expected result**
400 problem document.

item.name: 06 - Quota exhaustion flow (Regalia Gold, 3 visits)
item.description: Walks one card through its whole quarterly quota. Different lounges are used on purpose so the idempotent re-issue (same lounge) does not interfere. Run after folder 03 (request 3.3 already consumed visit #1).

item.name: 07 - Redeem pass at reception terminal
item.description: `POST /api/v1/lounge/redeem-pass` marks an issued pass as used. Requires the pass variables saved by folders 01-04.

request.description:
**Purpose**
An invented token must not redeem anything.

**Preconditions**
None.

**Steps**
1. Send token `LP-DOESNOTEXIST000000`.

**Expected result**
404 Not Found.

**Purpose**
A pass issued for HYD-T1-ENCORE cannot be used at another lounge.

**Preconditions**
Request 3.3 saved `passToken_regalia`.

**Steps**
1. Send `{{passToken_regalia}}` with `loungeId={{loungeIdB}}`.

**Expected result**
409 Conflict, detail says different lounge.

**Purpose**
Bean validation on the redeem request.

**Preconditions**
None.

**Steps**
1. Send `{}`.

**Expected result**
400 with `errors.passToken`.

item.name: 7.4 Redeem Axis pass at correct lounge -> REDEEMED

request.description:
**Purpose**
Happy path at the reception terminal.

**Preconditions**
Request 1.1 saved `passToken_axis` (pass valid 120 minutes).

**Steps**
1. Send `{{passToken_axis}}`, loungeId `{{loungeId}}`, terminalId `T-01`.

**Expected result**
200, `status=REDEEMED`, `redeemedAt` set.

**Purpose**
A pass is single-use.

**Preconditions**
Request 7.4 succeeded.

**Steps**
1. Send the same body as 7.4.

**Expected result**
409 Conflict, detail says already redeemed.

**Purpose**
Second happy-path redemption (different bank).

**Preconditions**
Request 4.1 saved `passToken_icici`.

**Steps**
1. Send `{{passToken_icici}}`.

**Expected result**
200 and `status=REDEEMED`.

**Purpose**
Happy path for the HDFC credit pass.

**Preconditions**
Request 3.3 saved `passToken_regalia`.

**Steps**
1. Send `{{passToken_regalia}}`.

**Expected result**
200 and `status=REDEEMED`.

item.name: 08 - Analytics
item.description: Run last so the numbers reflect every attempt made above plus the seeded history. Window = last N hours (default 24). 'approved' includes redeemed passes.

exec: pm.test("denial counts add up to denied", () => pm.expect(Object.values(s.denialsByReason).reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0)).to.eql(s.denied));
pm.test("HDFC and AXIS appear in bank distribution", () => { const banks = s.byBank.map(b=>b.bank); pm.expect(banks).to.include.members(["HDFC","AXIS"]); });

pm.test("topCardTiers has at most 5 entries, sorted desc", () => { pm.expect(s.topCardTiers.length).to.be.at.most(5); for (let i=1;i<s.topCardTiers.length;i++) pm.expect(s.topCardTiers[i-1].attempts).to.be.at.least(s.topCardTiers[i].attempts); });
pm.test("peak hours: max 3, non-zero", () => { pm.expect(s.peakEntryHours.length).to.be.within(1,3); s.peakEntryHours.forEach(h => pm.expect(h.attempts).to.be.above(0)); });

request.description:
**Purpose**
Real-time totals, approval vs rejection rate, denials by reason, bank distribution, top card tiers and peak hours.

**Preconditions**
Folders 01-07 executed (or at least the demo data is loaded).

**Steps**
1. Send the request (default `hours=24`).
2. Inspect `approvalRatePercent` + `rejectionRatePercent` (= 100).
3. Inspect `denialsByReason` - every reason is listed, zero when unseen.
4. Inspect `byBank`, `topCardTiers`, `peakEntryHours` (max 3) and `hourlyDistribution` (24 buckets).

**Expected result**
200 with the consistency checks in the Test Results tab passing.

exec: pm.test("window is 1 hour", () => pm.expect((new Date(s.windowEnd.substring(0,19)) - new Date(s.windowStart.substring(0,19)))/3600000).to.be.closeTo(1, 0.01));

request.description:
**Purpose**
Shorter windows exclude older seeded events.

**Preconditions**
Demo data loaded.

**Steps**
1. Send with `hours=1`.

**Expected result**
200; `windowEnd - windowStart` is one hour; totals are <= the 24h totals.

**Purpose**
Dedicated endpoint for the denial breakdown.

**Preconditions**
Demo data loaded.

**Steps**
1. Send the request.

**Expected result**
200 and a JSON map of reason -> count.

exec: pm.test("1-3 buckets, sorted desc", () => { pm.expect(h.length).to.be.within(1,3); for (let i=1;i<h.length;i++) pm.expect(h[i-1].attempts).to.be.at.least(h[i].attempts); });

request.description:
**Purpose**
Busiest hours of the day (top 3).

**Preconditions**
Demo data loaded.

**Steps**
1. Send the request.

**Expected result**
200 and up to three `{hour,label,attempts}` entries, busiest first.

**Purpose**
`hours` must be 1..8760.

**Preconditions**
None.

**Steps**
1. Send with `hours=0`.

**Expected result**
400 problem document.

**Purpose**
Upper bound check.

**Preconditions**
None.

**Steps**
1. Send with `hours=99999`.

**Expected result**
400 problem document.
